_doc: Per-machine round-win extraction rules. Default behaviour (machine not in any applies_to list) is byte-identical to legacy `r.get('WinCredits', 0)` lookup. See fresh_slotlab/round_win.py for rule type docs.
_added: 2026-04-27 -- v1 TopDollar settlement rule. Universal fallback synthesizer in parse_chunk_response handles all other unattributed-payid cases (no per-machine config needed).
_added_2026_05_12: v2 BCM cycle anchor rule (bcm_cycle_anchor type). Machines using BuffCollectionMap fire a bonus feature when CollectCount reaches the cycle peak; the trigger paid round emits no win==0 PayoutIdToWinAmount key, so default trigger-session anchor extraction missed the entire bonus block. M274 mode 1 saw 8.25% of bonus rounds (4.87% RTP) leak into `_unattributed_st139` before this rule; fleet sweep across 117 cached BCM (machine, mode) pairs found 55 with similar leakage (M250 at 100% / M268/M260/M264 at 70-90% / M163/M147 around 35%). Rollout strategy: enable per-machine as cached data is validated -- the rule augments rather than replaces default extraction, so over-attributing on a machine that doesn't actually have this trigger mechanic is benign (the synthetic anchor loses anchor-selection to any real numeric pid present on the same trigger round).
_added_2026_06_07: v3 M43 minigame settlement rule (synthesize_pay_id type). M43 ST51 (WinMiniGame) carries WinCredits>0 on 100% of rounds but NO PayoutIdToWinAmount (no round-level pid), so the parser's universal fallback dumps its entire 197,453,000 (30.7% of all win) into _unattributed_st51 and the RTP-integrity gate FAILS. The config-only SynthesizePayIdRule attributes the whole ST51 win to a single real pid 'st51' (label_format=spin_type), zeroing the fallback. PROVEN on M43's 41 real v3 chunks (_tmp/m43_reuse_audit/test_synth_rule.py): _unattributed_st51 197,453,000 -> 0, real pid 'st51' == 197,453,000 exact. The minigame's multiplier distribution is surfaced by the minigame_dynamics analysis (its own win/bet banding), NOT spread across multiplier-tier pids in the payid table (which for ST1/ST50 means symbol pids 2-9 -- a different identifier space). One honest feature row keeps the payid table semantically clean.
_added_2026_06_10: v4 M279 Wheel settlement rule (synthesize_pay_id type — EXACT M43 precedent). M279 ST2 (Wheel) carries WinCredits>0 on 100% of rounds with NO PayoutIdToWinAmount (and no BetAmount), so without this rule the whole 76,780,000 wheel prize (4.34% of all payback) lands in _unattributed_st2 and the RTP-integrity gate FAILS (layer2_fallback_buckets_found=['_unattributed_st2']). The config-only SynthesizePayIdRule attributes the whole ST2 win to a single real pid 'st2' (label_format=spin_type), zeroing the fallback. PROVEN config-only in 02_reuse.md (6 real chunks: _unattributed_st2 9,400,000 -> 0, real pid 'st2' == 9,400,000 exact). The wheel's discrete prize-lottery shape (5/10/20/30/50/100x, 12 cells, jackpot cells 8&10) lives in the wheel_dynamics analysis (play-keyed to 'Wheel'), NOT spread across multiplier-tier pids (per charter invariant 4). One honest feature row keeps the payid table semantically clean.
_added_2026_06_16: v5 M278 JewelFever (ST160) hold-and-respin settlement rule (synthesize_pay_id type — EXACT M43/M279 precedent). M278 ST160 (JewelFeverRespin, role hold_respin) settles ONCE per burst (single Settle=True, always-last round) but carries NO PayoutIdToWinAmount on 100% of 5,594 rows (incl. all 738 win-bearing settle rows — VERIFIED in 01_understanding.md). Without this rule the whole 74,523,800 ST160 prize (43.1% of all payback) lands in _unattributed_st160 and the RTP-integrity gate FAILS (layer2_fallback_buckets_found=['_unattributed_st160']). The config-only SynthesizePayIdRule attributes the whole ST160 win to a single real pid 'st160' (label_format=spin_type), zeroing the fallback. PROVEN config-only in 02_reuse.md (1 real chunk f33ddcf0: _unattributed_st160 74,523,800 -> 0, real pid 'st160' == 74,523,800 exact, rtp_integrity passed). The real felt shape — burst-length value-build, per-trigger-path split (3 jewel skins 5901/5902/5903 + collect_peak, premium-Red tier), settled multiplier banding — lives in the freespin_dynamics analysis (hold_respin role) + the trigger_paths anchor-walk dimension, NOT spread across multiplier-tier pids (per charter invariant 4). One honest feature row keeps the payid table semantically clean.

m225_wheel_settlement._doc: M225 Wheel (ST2) collect settlement: bare WinCredits with NO PayoutIdToWinAmount (and no BetAmount), ReMarks='WheelSpin CellIndex N; WheelId 1;' (20 cells). In the single cached mode_1 bucket the wheel paid 0 on 1557/1557 rounds (server FeatureWin 'Wheel'==0), so _unattributed_st2 is already 0 WITHOUT this rule. Declared for forward-compatibility (EXACT M279/M283 precedent): any win-bearing wheel round (other bucket/mode/re-sample) is attributed to a single real pid 'st2' (label_format=spin_type) instead of leaking to the fallback bucket and failing rtp-integrity. The 20-cell prize-lottery shape lives in the wheel_dynamics analysis (play-keyed 'Wheel'), NOT spread across multiplier-tier pids (charter invariant 4). EXACT M279/M283 precedent (m279_wheel_settlement / m283_wheel_settlement), config-only, no closure change.

m261_wheel_settlement._doc: M261 Wheel collect feature settles through TWO complementary no-payid channels: ST2 (WheelSpin, single-cell wheels: WinCredits>0 on 185/185 win rounds, no PayoutIdToWinAmount, no BetAmount) and ST137 (PreWheel aggregate, multi-cell wheels: WinCredits>0 on 338/338 win rounds carrying the credited Sum(ST2 WillWin), no PayoutIdToWinAmount). The two are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE per wheel episode (0 episodes win on both -> NO double-count; 185 ST2-only + 338 ST137-only across both chunks). Without this rule both prizes land in _unattributed_st2 + _unattributed_st137 and the RTP-integrity gate fails. label_format=spin_type attributes each to a single real pid 'st2' / 'st137' (each wheel-credit channel as one honest feature row). ST140 NormalCollectionSpin is fully payline-attributed (WinCredits==sum(payid) 80,000/80,000) and ST126 NewFreespin carries native payids (2,061/2,061), so neither needs synthesis (CLEAN synth, NOT a residual: ST2/ST137 carry no competing payline pid). The discrete wheel prize-lottery shape (CellIndex 2-14, 5 WheelId tiers) lives in the wheel_dynamics analysis (play-keyed to 'Wheel'), NOT spread across multiplier-tier pids (charter invariant 4). EXACT M247 PreWheel + M279/M283 Wheel SynthesizePayIdRule precedent (config-only, no closure change).

ST137 is a pure bare-WinCredits settlement (no payline payid alongside) = the CLEAN synth case, NOT a residual coin channel. bcm_cycle_anchor_m274._doc: M274 BuffCollectionMap: CollectCount accumulates 1..1000 across paid spins; at CC=1000 a ListRewardMinigame fires (ST=139 bonus rounds), then CC resets to 1. The trigger paid round carries PayoutIdToWinAmount={} (no anchor) -- distinct from the also-present pay_id 5801 minigame trigger path which DOES carry {'5801':0} and is handled by default extraction. 315 of 315 unattributed bonus blocks across 8 chunks of current md5 (847d89cd) deterministically preceded by a paid round with CollectCount==1000; the rule restores their attribution to the synthetic anchor '_bcm_cycle' and the analyzer's session-win loop credits the bonus session-total to it.

topdollar_selector_settlement._doc: TopDollar selector family (M12/M15/M90/M132): bonus flow is paid_trigger(ST=1, ReMarks='Trigger') -> N selector offer rounds (ST=14) showing OfferValue*bet as phantom WinCredits -> 1 settlement round (ST=15) carrying the actual payout in WinAmount (no WinCredits field). Without this rule the analyzer over-counts ST=14 phantom offers (variant 0/2 multi-pick) or under-counts ST=15 WinAmount (variant 1 single-pick where OfferValue==WinAmount happens to make the sum coincidentally match). Verified across all 13 fleet drift cases (B_overcount + C_undercount classes from drift scan). Variant 1 machines included even though our_total_win currently matches server_total_win -- phantom-offer attribution is still semantically wrong (per-SpinType / per-bucket round-level breakdown), so they get the same fix.

m24_collect_residual._doc: M24 collect-coin residual: STs [46] pay paylines (PayoutIdToWinAmount) PLUS a per-spin coin-collect win that the upstream does NOT itemize per pay_id (WinCredits > sum(payline pids)). WinResidualRule keeps the payline pids and attributes the residual (WinCredits - sum(payline pids)) to st<N>_collect, closing sum(payid)==chunk_win so _unattributed_* stays 0. Per-spin realized (WinCredits is the round truth); RTP unchanged. base_hash 8dde9c4df7c5.
